name: (08) Auspex — 3 Advanced — Bring Forth the Dawn

system.description: You may force another Kindred to succumb to the Daysleep by winning a Social Challenge against him. The victim sleeps one hour for every Beast Trait he has. This power can affect multiple targets (Mob Rule applies). The target can only be aroused by circumstances that would directly bring about his destruction (Storyteller's discretion), or may spend Willpower to remain awake at a rate of one Trait per hour.
